title_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale at Garden Residence by Salillari, Zoo!
description_en: The Salillari Residence, an oasis of tranquility between greenery and relaxation offered by the location of this residence near the fauna of the Zoo, and a few meters from the Tirana Artificial Lake. Information about the apartment: ~ 1st residential floor ~ Orientation North-East ~ Natural lighting in the apartment ~ Ventilated facade ~ ABB electrical installations ~ Double glazed windows with gasargon ~ Hidrosanitare inkaso/suspeso ~ With 2 elevators It is organized as follows: ~ Living room + kitchen room ~ 2 Bedrooms. ~ 2 Toilets ~ Balcony For more information or for a visit to the property, you can contact me!
